fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233638/rates (2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31 season: STANDARD ELECTRIC 30, MOORING 30, TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC 20), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Nine RV sites (RV1-RV9), all back-in with 57-75 ft driveways; also tent sites, a group shelter and eight cruiser (boat) sites where boaters must sleep aboard.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for facility 233638 (9 STANDARD ELECTRIC sites, Driveway Entry Back-In, Driveway Length 57-75) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233638 (notice: 'Boaters in cruiser sites (B1-B8) must sleep on their boat'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233638 (amenities 'Accessible Flush Toilets', 'Accessible Showers', 'Dump Station'; 'A trailer dump station is on site'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Bookable on recreation.gov up to the day of arrival (cutoff 0 days). Maximum 14 nights in any 30 consecutive days, shared with Ortona South Campground (same water resource project). Gate open 6 a.m. to sunset; card payments only.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233638 (facility_rules maxStay 14 nights 'Rolling 30 Days', reservationCutOff 0 days; notices on the shared Ortona South limit, gate hours and card-only payment), read 2026-10-21

summary: recreation.gov confirms $30 standard electric sites (2026/2027), 9 back-in RV sites with 50-amp + water, flush toilets, showers, dump; added the 14-nights-in-30 limit (shared with Ortona South) and same-day booking. Inherited reservable/platform now entry-verified. No minimum stay rule; window not stated in the facility record (left inherited); season left as derived from the calendar. --AWH note kept.
